articles.summary: OMAHA, Neb. (AP) — Boston Omaha Corp. (BOC) on Monday reported a fourth-quarter loss of $6.9 million, after reporting a profit in the same period a year earlier.  On a per-share basis, the Omaha, Nebraska-based company said it had a loss of 22 cents.  Boston Omaha shares have fallen almost 4% since the beginning of the year.
